title: Installment Schedule of the Installment Payment Plans
content:
**Spreading.** Under the **Installment Payment Plans**, the premium remaining after the down payment premium is spread over the plan's number of installments as equal installments rounded to the cent, the final installment absorbing any rounding difference.

**Due dates.** Installment 1 falls due the plan's first-installment interval in calendar months after the term effective date, and each later installment the plan's installment interval after the previous one, always on the plan's installment due day; in a month without that day the due date is the last calendar day of the month.

**Invoice contents — base clause, no longer in force as written.** The base sentence "each invoice is issued the plan's invoice lead time in calendar days before its due date and bills the installment premium, the plan's installment fee and every past-due amount still unpaid; its minimum due is their sum" is no longer in force; it is superseded by the current basis, which reads: for a draft notice on a plan billing an Owner Auto Policy term, and only for such a notice, the notice is issued the invoice lead time before its due date and bills what the draft notice schedule states; for the first invoice after an owner plan is moved off automatic draft to the Cardinal Point Six-Pay Direct Bill Plan at the named insured's request, and only for that invoice, the invoice is issued on the move's day and bills what the move's schedule states; any other invoice, a later invoice of a moved plan included, is issued the invoice lead time before its due date and bills the installment premium, the plan's installment fee with the certificate filing fee it bills, and every past-due amount still unpaid, its minimum due being their sum.

**One invoice per installment.** Only one installment invoice is issued per installment number of a plan; the plan's existing invoices are the evidence.

**Credits — base clause, no longer in force as written.** The base sentence "credits on the plan reduce the next installments nearest first; an installment fully covered by credit before its invoice date is not invoiced" is no longer in force; it is superseded by the current basis: for a Monthly EFT or Monthly Card Autopay plan billing an Owner Auto Policy term, and only for such a plan, a credit on the plan is carried onto its draft notices as the credit schedule sets, each installment is invoiced on its invoice date even when a credit covers it, and a credit still held when such a plan is moved off automatic draft to the Cardinal Point Six-Pay Direct Bill Plan at the named insured's request is carried onto the first invoice after the move as that invoice's own schedule sets, that invoice being issued even when the credit covers it; on any other plan, and on a moved plan after its first invoice, credits on the plan reduce the next installments nearest first, and an installment fully covered by credit before its invoice date is not invoiced.

**Paid-in-Full.** No installments exist on the Cardinal Point Paid-in-Full Plan.

**Example (hypothetical).** A term with a full-term premium of 1,000.00 on a plan whose down payment premium is 166.00 and which has 5 installments leaves 834.00 to spread: 834.00 divided by 5 is 166.80, so installments 1 to 4 are 166.80 and installment 5 is 834.00 less four times 166.80, which is 166.80. With a full-term premium of 1,001.00 and a down payment premium of 166.17, the 834.83 to spread gives 166.97 for installments 1 to 4 (166.966 rounded) and 834.83 less 667.88, which is 166.95, for installment 5.

superseded_clauses: Each invoice is issued invoice_lead_days calendar days before its due date and bills the installment premium, the plan's installment fee and every past-due amount still unpaid; its minimum_due is their sum.
Credits on the plan reduce the next installments nearest first; an installment fully covered by credit before its invoice date is not invoiced.
